entities.name: Władysław the White
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Władysław the White, also known in French as Ladislas Le Blanc, was a Polish prince and member of the House of Piast. He ruled as Duke of Gniewkowo during 1347/1350–1363/1364. He was the last male representative of Piast dynasty's Kuyavian line.
